svg.aria-label: P6-u: k_sem_init() of an object with a waiter (undefined behavior)

g.data-tip: Same thread priority (1): t1 (preemptible), t2 (preemptible), t3 (preemptible). These contexts cannot preempt each other. A pending one waits until the running one ends or blocks.
g.title: Same thread priority (1): t1 (preemptible), t2 (preemptible), t3 (preemptible). These contexts cannot preempt each other. A pending one waits until the running one ends or blocks.

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): t1 runs. t1 runs its own code in thread mode.
g.title: t1 (preemptible): t1 runs. t1 runs its own code in thread mode.

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): k_sem_take(o1). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). k_sem_take(o1, K_FOREVER) (sem.c:127): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:134). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The count is 0: z_pend_curr() (sem.c:153). The model object o1 stands for each object: each wait of an object calls z_pend_curr().
g.title: t1 (preemptible): k_sem_take(o1). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). k_sem_take(o1, K_FOREVER) (sem.c:127): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:134). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The count is 0: z_pend_curr() (sem.c:153). The model object o1 stands for each object: each wait of an object calls z_pend_curr().

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): z_pend_curr(). z_pend_curr() (sched.c:531) -> pend_locked() (sched.c:559) -> add_to_waitq_locked() (sched.c:429) -> unready_thread() (sched.c:434): t1 leaves the run queue and waits on o1. unready_thread() calls update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t2 (sched.c:173).
g.title: t1 (preemptible): z_pend_curr(). z_pend_curr() (sched.c:531) -> pend_locked() (sched.c:559) -> add_to_waitq_locked() (sched.c:429) -> unready_thread() (sched.c:434): t1 leaves the run queue and waits on o1. unready_thread() calls update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t2 (sched.c:173).

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): z_swap(): switch. z_swap_locked() (sched.c:561, kswap.h:234) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:183, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t2 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).
g.title: t1 (preemptible): z_swap(): switch. z_swap_locked() (sched.c:561, kswap.h:234) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:183, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t2 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).

g.data-tip: t2 (preemptible): t2 runs. t2 runs its own code in thread mode.
g.title: t2 (preemptible): t2 runs. t2 runs its own code in thread mode.

g.data-tip: t2 (preemptible): k_sem_init(o1). Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). z_impl_k_sem_init() -> z_waitq_init(&sem->wait_q) (sem.c:62): the list (wait_q.h:88-91, CONFIG_WAITQ_SIMPLE) or the tree (wait_q.h:41-47, CONFIG_WAITQ_SCALABLE) is empty again. No lock, no check of the waiters. t1 still wait(s) with pended_on = o1: no wake of o1 finds them. Undefined behavior: the model stops (panic = 'undefined').
g.title: t2 (preemptible): k_sem_init(o1). Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). z_impl_k_sem_init() -> z_waitq_init(&sem->wait_q) (sem.c:62): the list (wait_q.h:88-91, CONFIG_WAITQ_SIMPLE) or the tree (wait_q.h:41-47, CONFIG_WAITQ_SCALABLE) is empty again. No lock, no check of the waiters. t1 still wait(s) with pended_on = o1: no wake of o1 finds them. Undefined behavior: the model stops (panic = 'undefined').
